resources.string: Use system GPS, network, and cached locations. Start one foreground request manually; leaving stops it. Default coordinates are never shown as real locations.
Location permission is needed to get your current position. Approximate access is supported. This demo does not request background access.
Location permission was not granted. Retry or change access in app settings.
Getting a location; waiting up to 10 seconds…
No real location was received. Check location services and permissions, then retry.
Location stopped. You can start another request.
Find nearby place names in the bundled GeoNames database. Results are approximate, not street addresses or location accuracy. The first query copies the database.
Enter valid latitude and longitude values.
No nearby place found. Check the coordinates; the database may not cover this area.
